name: Rīga Stradiņš University
summary: Riga health-sciences university with English-taught Medicine, Dentistry and a business bachelor; places are ranked on secondary-school grades.

ib.text: No IB-specific page: the Diploma counts as secondary education, IB Higher Level grades are given priority, and the minimum grade is 5 of 7 in required subjects. English is shown by a test or by schooling in English.

dates.label: Medicine and Dentistry: application period opens (EU/EEA)

programmes.name: Medicine
programmes.about: Six-year English-taught MD (360 ECTS) built around patient-centred problems and group work, with work with patients from the third year and simulation training at the university's simulation centre.
programmes.ib: Grades in English, Maths and Biology and/or Chemistry; IB HL grades count first and at least 70% is needed in each.

needs.note: English is a programme-specific subject; IB minimum grade 5 of 7
Biology and/or Chemistry; having both is an advantage; 70%+ needed

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the average percentage in English, Biology and/or Chemistry and Maths; IB HL grades are prioritised. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Dentistry
programmes.about: Five-year English-taught dentistry degree (300 ECTS): diagnosis, restorative treatment, implants and dental public health, practised first on simulation models and then in clinic.
programmes.ib: Grades in English, Maths, Biology and Chemistry; at least 80% in the required subjects, and applicants with both Biology and Chemistry are prioritised.

needs.note: English is a programme-specific subject; IB minimum grade 5 of 7
Both preferred and prioritised; 80%+ needed in required subjects

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the average percentage in English, Biology and Chemistry and Maths; applicants with both sciences come first. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: International Business and Start-up Entrepreneurship
programmes.about: A three-year business bachelor on international business and start-up economics, with project semesters, simulations, placements and pitching to investors with the university's business incubator.

needs.note: English is a programme-specific subject; IB minimum grade 5 of 7

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the average percentage in English and Maths; Latvian counts only for diplomas from Latvian schools. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Medicine and Dentistry add a one-off 1,800 euro registration fee to tuition, and every applicant pays a 100 euro application fee; tuition is paid per semester.
Online motivational interviews are set for non-EU/EEA applicants; EU/EEA applicants are ranked on their grades alone.
IB graduates finishing in summer may send final diploma documents after the deadline if everything else is in by 1 July (rule as published for the 2026 intake).
